question: Which month in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes for customers and subscribers?	Which month (in number) in 2017 had the largest absolute difference between cumulative bike usage minutes (in thousands) for customers and subscribers, based on the trip end dates in the San Francisco bikeshare data?
sql:
WITH monthly_usage AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60000.0 AS total_minutes_thousands
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Subscriber', 'Customer')
  GROUP BY month_num, subscriber_type
)
SELECT
  month_num,
  MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) AS subscriber_minutes,
  MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) AS customer_minutes,
  ABS(
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE NULL END)
  ) AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM monthly_usage
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY abs_diff_thousands DESC
LIMIT 1
